mechanism: Aspirin may increase mefloquine levels through protein binding displacement and potential CYP3A4 competition, while mefloquine's CNS effects may be potentiated; aspirin also increases bleeding risk independent of mefloquine.
action: Monitor for mefloquine toxicity signs (neuropsychiatric symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias) and bleeding; use aspirin cautiously or consider alternative analgesics; maintain adequate hydration.
